assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a 2D Canvas cat running animation.
Input image 1 is the approved cat identity and painterly style reference, NOT a pose to copy.
Generate ONE sprite sheet with EXACTLY EIGHT full-body drawings of this SAME cream-white short-haired round-faced cat, arranged in a strict FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS equal-cell grid. Landscape 2:1 canvas, transparent alpha background. Each cell contains one entire cat including tail with generous clear gutters; no overlap between cells, no cropping, no borders, no numbers, no text, no ground or shadow.
All eight poses face RIGHT in a consistent side view with the same camera, body proportions, head size, warm cream brushwork, angular painted shadows, pink ears, dark blue-gray eyes. Gently rounded British shorthair build, same as reference, not flat cartoon or 3D plastic. Tail extends behind to the left. No accessories.
This is a continuous anatomically plausible RUN CYCLE, read left to right, top row then bottom row:
1 front paw contact: near front leg reaches forward/down, other foreleg folded, hind legs trailing.
2 weight accepted: forelegs under chest bent, hind legs drawing forward under belly.
3 gathered suspension: rounded back, all four legs tucked under body, hind paws toward front.
4 hind contact: hind feet under hips ready to push, forelegs reaching forward.
5 hind push: hind legs extending backward, forelegs stretching forward, torso lengthens.
6 extended suspension: forelegs ahead and hind legs behind, belly elongated, all paws airborne.
7 forelegs sweeping down to prepare contact, hind knees beginning to fold.
8 alternate front paw contact with near/far leg relationships visibly different from frame 1, to lead smoothly back into it.
Use consistent scale and keep torso center at the same within-cell x/y in all frames. Ground contact line in each cell at 85% height, head near 30% height, enough room for stretched paws. Make the eight leg configurations clearly different and usable for animation, not eight duplicates. Fine visible fur brush strokes and soft natural daylight. True transparent background throughout all gutters and around every cat.
assets.correctionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target is this eight-pose transparent cat sprite atlas. Correct ONLY the spacing and registration so a game can extract the eight sprites safely. Preserve all eight distinct original poses, identity, cream fur brushwork and transparency. 
Strict equal FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid across a landscape 2:1 transparent image. EXACTLY EIGHT cats, same order. Scale EVERY cat uniformly DOWN so each full silhouette fits inside the central 72% of its own cell width and central 72% of cell height. Include the ENTIRE tail, whiskers and paws within that inset. This means a wide EMPTY TRANSPARENT GUTTER at least 14% of cell width on BOTH sides of each cell and 14% of cell height top and bottom. Especially the longest horizontal stretched cat must not cross into adjacent cell. Do not stretch cats individually or crop tails; use same scale for all. Each silhouette horizontally centered in its cell, lowest paw at 84% cell height. Background MUST be actual alpha transparency, no checkerboard painted in, no solid background, no shadows, no text, no lines. Keep strong consistent painted detail.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a 2D Canvas cat jump animation.
Input image 1 is the approved cat identity and painterly style reference, NOT a pose to copy.
Generate ONE sprite sheet with EXACTLY EIGHT full-body drawings of this SAME cream-white short-haired round-faced cat in a strict FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS equal-cell grid. Landscape 2:1 canvas, transparent alpha. Every cat wholly inside its own cell with clear gutters, tail included. No borders, numbers, text, scenery, ground, or shadows.
All eight poses face RIGHT, constant side view and SAME animal size, head size, fur colors, warm cream brushwork, angular painted gray-beige shadow planes, pink ears and dark blue-gray eyes. Natural slightly rounded British shorthair anatomy matching reference; no clothes. Tail behind to the left.
Read top row left to right, then bottom row. These eight DIFFERENT coherent key poses form a small playful forward JUMP:
1 calm standing on four paws, relaxed tail.
2 deep anticipation crouch, belly low, hind knees folded beneath hips, head intent forward.
3 powerful take-off, hind paws pushing against ground behind, body angled up about 25 degrees, forepaws raised.
4 rising into air, front paws bent together toward chest, hind legs folding, alert face.
5 apex of leap, body stretched almost horizontally, forelegs reaching forwards, hind legs trailing, balancing tail.
6 descending, front paws extended forward/down ready to touch ground, hips above shoulders, hind legs tucked.
7 soft landing crouch, front paws planted and bent, hind paws arriving beneath body, body low.
8 relaxed four-paw standing recovery, similar to pose 1.
Each drawing centered in its own cell, constant head and body size; DO NOT move the airborne poses high within their cells: code handles trajectory, this sheet supplies body poses. Preserve full silhouettes and consistent scale, allowing height changes from actual crouching only. Maximum fur-to-tail width about 85% cell width. Clean painterly illustration edges with real alpha transparency.
